entries.title: Player loot and reset commands
entries.summary: Default player accounts have the listed pickup, auto-loot, and respec commands.
details: Group 0 (the default player group) can use @autopickup, @autoloot, @alootid, @autoloottype, and @noautolootid.
Automatic ground pickup starts at 2 cells; parties impose this configured radius. Player pickup reservations, party sharing, map flags, weight, and inventory capacity still apply.
Auto-loot drop-rate checks do not include player drop-rate bonuses and penalties.
Group 0 can use @streset and @skreset for free stat and skill resets, plus @refundskill to refund eligible skills.
The command permissions and defaults are configured values; per-character auto-loot selections and pickup settings can differ at runtime.

entries.title: Party experience sharing
entries.summary: Eligible even-share parties receive the configured bonus before EXP is divided.
details: Even-share bonus: 25% per additional eligible member.
Maximum member level spread: 30 levels.
Party EXP sharing is map-scoped; this configuration does not set a cell-distance limit.
The 30-level spread is a playtest candidate, not a final balance decision.

entries.title: Death penalty and recovery
entries.summary: Death-penalty rates and the Korangar recovery rule, sourced from effective configuration.
details: Death penalty rates apply to EXP earned in the current level.
Configured base EXP penalty rate: 1.00% of current-level EXP.
Configured job EXP penalty rate: 1.00% of current-level EXP.
Configured Zeny death penalty rate: 0.00%.
Recovery enabled: yes.
When enabled, recovery returns 50% of measured EXP losses after 10 eligible same-map monster kills or arrival within 4 cells of the save point.
Map flags, class exemptions, or a zero actual loss can prevent a death penalty and therefore leave nothing to recover.
